Bill.BriefDescription: Providing an incentive to improve on-time graduation rates at institutions of higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to graduation rate improvements; and amending RCW28B.10.693.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.10.693 and 1993 c 414 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each institution of higher education as defined in RCW28B.10.016 may enter into a student progression understanding with aninterested student. The terms of the understanding shall permit astudent to obtain a degree or certificate within the standard period oftime assumed for a fulltime student pursuing that degree orcertificate. ((Usually, the standard amount of time will be about twoyears for an associate of arts degree and about four years for abaccalaureate degree.)) Student progression understandings shall notgive rise to any cause of action on behalf of any student as a resultof the failure of any state institution of higher education to fulfillits obligations under the student progression understanding. (2) A student who signs a progression understanding shall pay thesame tuition during his or her period of enrollment, under the p. 1 SB 5174progression understanding, as he or she did for his or her initialterm. As used in this subsection and subsection (3) of this section,"tuition" means "operating fees" as defined in RCW 28B.15.031. (3) If the student does not obtain the degree or certificate withinthe period of time established in the progression understanding, thestudent must pay the difference in tuition increases, with interest.If the student does not obtain the degree or certificate within theperiod of time established in the progression understanding due to thefailure of the state institution of higher education to fulfill itsobligations, the payment requirement in this subsection does not apply.
